name: Imagine Worldwide, Malawi (Founders Pledge)
summary: Tablet-based, child-led learning software for primary-school pupils, scaled nationwide in Malawi with a planned government takeover. A re-implementation of Founders Pledge's 2023 cost-effectiveness analysis, which values learning gains through later income, in WELLBYs.

rows.label: Founders Pledge's value per dollar (WELLBY-equivalents)
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's multiple of GiveDirectly times its GiveDirectly value per dollar: the multiple back in its value units.

rows.label: Units of ln(income) per dollar
rows.explainer: charityevals' step. Founders Pledge's 2022 'WELLBYs' are its own unit of value, built from its moral weights (3.7 per healthy year, 1.9 per doubled income-year), not life-satisfaction points measured in surveys, so they are not converted at the WELLBY exchange rate. The whole benefit here is income, so dividing by Founders Pledge's value of one unit of ln(income) gives back the income gain itself.

rows.label: Units of value per dollar
rows.explainer: The income gain valued like every income gain on the site: GiveWell's units of value per unit of ln(consumption) (one unit = doubling one person's income for a year).

rows.label: Staff pay as a share of program cost
rows.explainer: Default for programs that mostly buy and hand out goods (nets, drugs, supplements, vaccines, water treatment): staff pay is a small part of the cost. Our judgment; we haven't seen this program's breakdown.

rows.label: Pay gap versus comparable jobs elsewhere
rows.explainer: Delivery staff are mostly hired locally at local rates, so the gap is small. Our judgment.

rows.label: Salary forgone by staff per dollar of cost (in-kind donation)
Share of the full cost paid in cash
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost, and staff get their share of the outcome. Off, this is 100%.

rows.label: Units of value per dollar
rows.explainer: Income gains in GiveWell's units of value. With credit by share of resources, times the share of the full cost paid in cash (staff's forgone pay is the rest).
